PublicChannel.description: The medium through which a service user interacts with the council (e.g., Phone, Online, In-Person).

CouncilAgent.description: Agents are interfaces which allow service users to contact and use a council’s services.

Capability.description: Capabilities are tools that council agents use to meet the needs of their service users.

ITSystem.description: The actual physical software application, SaaS, or platform (e.g., Generic CRM, GovPay).

FunctionGroup.description: The overarching service domain or directorate (e.g., Adult Social Care, Environmental Services).

Layer.description: A top-level category in the LGAM architecture.

nodes.label: Public Channels
nodes.description: Public channels are how service users interact with councils.

nodes.label: In person
nodes.description: Face-to-face interactions at a council office, a user's home or business, or another physical location.

nodes.label: Phone
nodes.description: Voice calls allowing users to speak directly with council staff for support, enquiries, or complex transactions.

nodes.label: Email
nodes.description: Asynchronous written messages used for direct communication between users and the council.

nodes.label: Letter
nodes.description: Physical postal mail used for formal notifications, legal correspondence, or providing a permanent physical record.

nodes.label: Online
nodes.description: Websites, web portals, apps, and online forms enabling users to self-serve and access information digitally.

nodes.label: Messaging
nodes.description: Text-based messages including SMS, used to provide quick updates, alerts, or appointment reminders.

nodes.label: Social media
nodes.description: Social networking platforms used to broadcast information, answer queries, and engage with the community.

nodes.label: Smart devices
nodes.description: Connected hardware (such as Internet of Things sensors or smart speakers) enabling automated or voice-activated interactions.

nodes.label: Third-party channels
nodes.description: Indirect channels where users interact via a proxy, such as a local MP, an advocate, or local media.

nodes.label: Video
nodes.description: Remote video calls enabling face-to-face conversations without the need to travel to a council building.

nodes.label: Council Interfaces
nodes.description: Interfaces through which councils deliver services and information.

nodes.label: Apps
nodes.description: Both native and cross-platform mobile applications providing dedicated services to citizens.

nodes.label: API gateways
nodes.description: Machine-to-machine interfaces handling third-party integrations and smart device inputs.

nodes.label: Automated phones
nodes.description: Automated telephony systems, such as IVR and conversational voicebots.

nodes.label: Human
nodes.description: Customer service representatives or specialist officers handling queries.

nodes.label: Public devices
nodes.description: Publicly-accessible devices owned by the council, such as touch-screens in a library or Internet of Things sensors in a drain or bin.

nodes.label: Websites
nodes.description: Primary council web portals, forms, webchat, and other digital content interfaces.

nodes.label: Capabilities
nodes.description: Capabilities used by council's interfaces to help them meet the needs of their service users.

nodes.label: Agentic AI
nodes.description: Autonomous AI agents capable of reasoning, executing multi-step tasks, and making routing decisions.

nodes.label: Booking
nodes.description: Capabilities used to arrange and manage appointments or service slots, such as inspections and interviews with users.

nodes.label: Email
nodes.description: Capabilities used to send and receive messages when dealing with users and both internal and external stakeholders.

nodes.label: Forms
nodes.description: Capabilities used to collect and check information provided by users, such as within applications, reports, and requests.

nodes.label: Identity
nodes.description: Capabilities used to check and verify a user's identity.

nodes.label: Payments
nodes.description: Tools used to take and track payments made by users for services such as paying council taxes, and getting licences and permits.

nodes.label: Messaging
nodes.description: Tools used to send and receive text messages including SMS, for updates, reminders, and quick communications with users.

nodes.label: Telephony and fax
nodes.description: Capabilities used to communicate or exchange information with users via voice calls or fax.

nodes.label: Workflow
nodes.description: Capabilities used to manage and track users' requests, applications, or casework as the users move through different processing stages.

nodes.label: Business Areas
nodes.description: Business areas cover the specific functions each council must provide. Each area features individual technology components designed for a specific need.

nodes.label: Adult social care
nodes.description: The provision of support services for adults with physical or mental health needs, and their carers.

nodes.label: Childrens’ social care
nodes.description: The provision of services, including child protection and safeguarding, family support, and care for looked-after children and care leavers.

nodes.label: Democratic services
nodes.description: The management of elections, committee meetings, and support for elected councillors.

nodes.label: Education
nodes.description: The management of school admissions, transport, special educational needs, and support for local educational settings.

nodes.label: Highways and transport
nodes.description: The management of road maintenance, traffic, public transport planning, and parking.

nodes.label: Housing
nodes.description: The management of social housing, repairs, and homelessness prevention.

nodes.label: Leisure and culture
nodes.description: The operation of parks, libraries, museums, leisure centres, and community events.

nodes.label: Licensing and regulation
nodes.description: The processing of alcohol, taxi, and trade licences, and environmental health enforcement.

nodes.label: Planning and development
nodes.description: The processing of planning applications, building control, and local spatial planning.

nodes.label: Public health
nodes.description: The provision of community health initiatives, sexual health services, and health protection.

nodes.label: Revenues and benefits
nodes.description: The collection of council tax and business rates, and administration of housing benefit.

nodes.label: Waste management
nodes.description: The management of kerbside collections, recycling, and the operation of household waste centres.

nodes.label: Corporate Areas
nodes.description: Corporate areas are required functions not specific to councils, each with their own individual technology components.

nodes.label: Business planning and performance
nodes.description: The administration of strategic planning, performance monitoring, and business intelligence.

nodes.label: Communications and PR
nodes.description: The management of press relations, public campaigns, and omnichannel content publishing.

nodes.label: Corporate governance and risk
nodes.description: The management of internal audits, risk, and constitutional compliance.

nodes.label: Customer relationship (B2C)
nodes.description: The management of customer service centres and general resident engagement.

nodes.label: Facilities
nodes.description: The maintenance and management of council-owned buildings and estates.

nodes.label: Financial
nodes.description: The administration of accounting, treasury management, payroll, and budget setting.

nodes.label: Geographical
nodes.description: The management of geographic identity system (GIS) data, mapping services, and gazetteers.

nodes.label: Legal and compliance
nodes.description: The provision of legal advice, litigation services, and data protection (GDPR) compliance.

nodes.label: Human resources and workforce
nodes.description: The management of recruitment, staff training, performance, and employee relations.

nodes.label: Procurement (B2B)
nodes.description: The management of contracts, supply chains, and purchasing of goods and services.

nodes.label: Foundational Technology
nodes.description: Technology platforms and capabilities that underpin council service delivery.

nodes.label: Integration
nodes.description: Integrations ensure systems, applications, and data sources can seamlessly connect and share information to provide consistent data and unified digital experiences across the organisation.

nodes.label: API management and gateways
nodes.description: Platforms and services for designing, publishing, securing, and monitoring APIs, often combined with API developer portals/catalogues for discovery and governance.

nodes.label: Data integration and pipelines (ETL/ELT)
nodes.description: Tools and processes for extracting, transforming, and loading data between systems, supporting both batch ETL and real-time ELT pipelines.

nodes.label: Event-driven and streaming integration
nodes.description: Platforms for capturing and distributing real-time event streams, enabling responsive, event-driven architectures.

nodes.label: File transfer management
nodes.description: Managed File Transfer (MFT) solutions to securely exchange files between systems or with external partners, ensuring scheduling, auditing, and integrity of bulk data transfers.

nodes.label: Integration governance and tooling
nodes.description: Secure by design integration architecture and governance processes supported by integration platforms and tools. These establish common integration patterns, standards, and reusable components for consistency and incorporate security & privacy by design principles (e.g. authentication, encryption, policy enforcement) into integration solutions.

nodes.label: Message-oriented middleware
nodes.description: Enterprise service buses (ESB) and message brokers that route, transform, and orchestrate interactions between applications.

nodes.label: Partner (B2B) integration
nodes.description: Capabilities for business-to-business (B2B) and partner data exchange, including supporting EDI standards, secure partner API connections, and external data-sharing agreements.

nodes.label: Security
nodes.description: Security encompasses all capabilities, tools, and practices that protect the organisation's people, data, systems, and services from threats and ensure resilience against disruption.

nodes.label: Application and data security
nodes.description: Capabilities to secure applications and data through secure development practices, data protection controls, and continuous security testing. This involves application security testing (SAST/DAST) during development, enforcing data classification & encryption, protecting APIs, and monitoring for application-level threats.

nodes.label: Identity and access management (IAM)
nodes.description: Capabilities to verify identities and control access to systems that may use Zero Trust principles. This includes authentication and authorisation services (e.g. single sign-on, multi-factor authentication) to ensure only the right users/devices get appropriate access.

nodes.label: Incident forensics
nodes.description: Digital forensic analysis capabilities including tools to collect and analyse digital evidence when breaches occur.

nodes.label: Network and endpoint security
nodes.description: Network, endpoint, and device protection measures to guard against malware, intrusions, and unauthorised access. This includes firewalls, endpoint protection, intrusion detection/prevention systems, network segmentation, and device compliance monitoring.

nodes.label: Physical security and access control
nodes.description: Management of physical access and on-site security, including badge access systems, CCTV surveillance, and facility security controls.

nodes.label: Security operations and monitoring (SOC)
nodes.description: Continuous security monitoring and incident management via a Security Operations Centre (SOC). SOC capabilities often include SIEM (Security Information & Event Management) tools and threat detection platforms to maintain real-time visibility of the security posture.

nodes.label: Vulnerability and threat management
nodes.description: Tools and processes to identify, assess, and remediate vulnerabilities in systems, as well as manage cyber threat intelligence. This covers regular vulnerability scanning, prioritising patches based on risk, tracking emerging threats, and verifying configuration security.

nodes.label: Data and Information
nodes.description: Data and information management encompasses the capabilities, tools, and practices that equip the organisation to collect, manage, understand, and utilise its data and information assets in an effective manner.

nodes.label: Business intelligence and analytics
nodes.description: BI and analytics platforms for aggregating data and creating reports, dashboards, and visualisations to inform decision-making. This includes interactive data exploration, performance metrics, and trend analysis .

nodes.label: Data catalogue & metadata management
nodes.description: Systems for cataloguing data assets and managing metadata across the organisation, enabling data discovery and understanding. This includes data dictionaries, metadata repositories, and lineage tracking.

nodes.label: Data governance and quality
nodes.description: Tools for managing data assets consistently and ethically throughout their lifecycle.

nodes.label: Data science and predictive analytics
nodes.description: Advanced analytics capabilities for statistical analysis, predictive modelling, and data mining to identify patterns, forecast outcomes, and support data-driven decisions.

nodes.label: Data storage and warehousing
nodes.description: Data storage platforms for structured and unstructured data, providing scalable databases, data warehouses, and data lakes for analytical and operational needs.

nodes.label: Document and records management
nodes.description: Enterprise document management and records archiving capabilities to organise, store, and retain unstructured information throughout their lifecycle.

nodes.label: Enterprise search and data indexing
nodes.description: Capabilities to search and index data and content. This may involve enterprise search engines, indexing services, and taxonomy/metadata tagging.

nodes.label: Geospatial data
nodes.description: Data for mapping, geospatial analysis, and location based services.

nodes.label: Social Care System
nodes.description: Core case management system for Adult and Children's statutory social care.

nodes.label: Waste System
nodes.description: Operational system for managing domestic/commercial waste collection and fleet routing.

nodes.label: Electoral System
nodes.description: Specialist system for electoral registration and ballot management.

nodes.label: Corporate CRM
nodes.description: Centralised system for managing citizen interactions and service requests.

nodes.label: Revs and Bens System
nodes.description: System for processing council tax, business rates, and housing benefits.

nodes.label: Income Management System
nodes.description: Corporate income management, receipting, and cash management platform.

nodes.label: HR & Payroll System
nodes.description: Human resources, staff management, recruitment, and payroll processing.

nodes.label: Environmental Health System
nodes.description: Regulatory system for protection, trading standards, and food safety.

nodes.label: Housing Management System
nodes.description: System covering tenancies, allocations, rents, and repairs.

nodes.label: Leisure Management System
nodes.description: Booking and facility management platform for leisure centers and cultural venues.

nodes.label: Planning & Building Control System
nodes.description: System managing spatial planning applications and building control.

nodes.label: Highways Management System
nodes.description: Asset management system for roads, street lighting, and parking.

nodes.label: Corporate ERP
nodes.description: Enterprise Resource Planning for core back-office finance and procurement.

nodes.label: Library Management System
nodes.description: System for cataloging, loans, and membership management.

nodes.label: Education Management System
nodes.description: Management information system for schools, pupil admissions, and early years.
